verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a high-performance relay that Enterprise customers can run as "a relay point in your firewall", so relayed session traffic can stay on infrastructure the admin runs. Connections are otherwise peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure. The evidence is thin marketing copy and Enterprise-only, and nothing shows the rendezvous or signaling and authentication service can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: self-hostable rendezvous/signaling, relay deployment documentation, availability outside the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run

citations.quote: The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
a high-performance relay server adds even more control
All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
